newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banamex 9-mos net rises 28 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: Banamex 9-mos net rises 28 pct on year.

text.p: Grupo Financero Banamex-Accival (Banacci) said that its banking subsidiary Banco Nacional de Mexico (Banamex) reported a net profit of 1.894 billion pesos in the first nine months of the year.
It said that was 28 percent higher than the same period a year earlier.
Banamex's capitalisation ratio was 14.9 percent at the end of September, compared with 14.0 percent at the end of June, it said.
It said that the nine-month operating profit of Banacci rose 49 percent over the same period a year earlier to 2.848 billion pesos.
The financial group said that the increase included a non-recurring gain for Arrendadora Banamex of 396 million pesos.
Without that extraordinary gain, the operating profits of the company would have been 2.452 billion pesos, 28 percent higher than in the first nine-months of 1995.

The brokerage arm of the financial group, Accival, showed an accumulated profit of 182 million pesos in the first nine months, an increase of 19 percent compared to the first nine months of the previous year.
Seguros Banamex-AEGON reported a profit of 91 million pesos in the first nine months, compared with 34 million pesos in the same period a year before.

The company said that during the third quarter the bad loan portfolio, before charges, grew 4.0 percent, compared with growth of 9.0 percent in the first quarter of 1996 and the 5.0 percent growth in the second quarter of 1996.
